d7.label: Camp kitchen, three years, no papers

transcript.text: 我一直是做饭的，在厨房干了好多年了。
transcript.en: I've always been a cook. I've worked in kitchens for years.

transcript.text: 在营地的厨房我干了三年，每天差不多要做两百个人的饭。
transcript.en: In the camp kitchen I worked for three years, cooking for about two hundred people every day.

transcript.text: 早上五点就开始了，先蒸米饭，然后炖肉、熬汤，一大锅一大锅的。
transcript.en: We started at five in the morning. Rice first, then stewing the meat and making soup, one huge pot after another.

transcript.text: 后来我带几个人，四五个吧，谁切菜谁洗锅，都是我来安排。
transcript.en: Later I had a few people with me, four or five. I decided who chopped vegetables and who washed the pots.

transcript.text: 肉是每天早上送来的，我先看新不新鲜，不新鲜的就不能用。
transcript.en: The meat was delivered every morning. I checked first whether it was fresh, and if it wasn't, we couldn't use it.

transcript.text: 生的和熟的一定要分开放，砧板和刀也分开用。冰箱的温度我每天记两次，写在本子上。
transcript.en: Raw and cooked food always had to be kept apart, with separate chopping boards and knives too. I wrote down the fridge temperature twice a day in a notebook.

transcript.text: 证书我没有，一张都没有。可是这些活儿我都会做。
transcript.en: I don't have a certificate, not a single one. But I can do all of this work.

transcript.text: 在这边我想先找个厨房的工作，然后再慢慢学。
transcript.en: Here I'd like to find a kitchen job first, and then keep learning bit by bit.

d7_welding.label: Structural steel welder, seven years, no certificate

transcript.text: 我是焊工，干了七年多了。
transcript.en: I'm a welder. I've done it for more than seven years.

transcript.text: 主要是焊钢结构，厂房的钢梁啊、楼梯啊、栏杆这些。
transcript.en: Mostly structural steel: beams for factory buildings, stairs, railings, that kind of thing.

transcript.text: 电焊条的我会，气保焊也会，就是用焊丝的那种。氩弧焊做得少一点。
transcript.en: I can weld with stick electrodes, and gas-shielded too, the kind with the wire. I did less TIG.

transcript.text: 切割也是我自己来，用氧气乙炔割钢板。
transcript.en: I did the cutting myself as well, cutting steel plate with oxy-acetylene.

transcript.text: 图纸我看得懂。师傅把图给我，我自己量、自己下料。
transcript.en: I can read drawings. The foreman gave me the drawing, and I measured and cut the material myself.

transcript.text: 干活的时候面罩、手套一定要戴，旁边不能放油和纸，怕着火。
transcript.en: When working, the mask and gloves always went on, and no oil or paper was kept nearby, because of fire.

transcript.text: 证书我没有，但是你给我一块钢板，我焊给你看。
transcript.en: I don't have a certificate, but give me a steel plate and I'll weld it to show you.

d7_lowconfidence.label: Unclear whether the work was paid

transcript.text: 我在我叔叔的厨房帮过忙。
transcript.en: I helped out in my uncle's kitchen.
